segments.name: Property Operations
segments.description: Owns and operates land lease properties, including manufactured home, RV communities and marinas, leasing sites to residents and guests.
segments.evidence: The Property Operations segment owns and operates land lease Properties and the Home Sales and Rentals Operations segment purchases, sells and leases homes at the Properties.

segments.name: Home Sales and Rentals Operations
segments.description: Purchases, sells and leases factory-built homes at the properties and offers brokerage services to residents selling their homes.
segments.evidence: The Property Operations segment owns and operates land lease Properties and the Home Sales and Rentals Operations segment purchases, sells and leases homes at the Properties.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company to lease developed sites or for right-to-use membership subscriptions, and the company also earns revenue from selling, leasing and brokering homes.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers may lease individual developed areas ("Sites") or enter into right-to-use contracts, also known as membership subscriptions, which provide them access to specific Properties for limited stays.
